name: lilty
description: GUI framework for 128x64 monochrome OLEDs: spring-driven animation, a layer stack, focus navigation and a small widget set. C++ rewrite of the lilt project (https://github.com/chhongzh/lilt), with display and input backends kept in separate folders so the core can be ported to other hardware.
keywords: oled, gui, sh1106, ssd1306, menu, rotary, encoder, spring, animation, esp32
